evaluation.summary: FrontierU is building a private global community for ambitious young people with Socrates, a personalised AI mentor and tutor. The published Founding Engineer role strongly matches Paarth's production-agent, backend-infrastructure, evaluation, observability, payments, queues, concurrency, CI/CD, and end-to-end product ownership experience. The central risk is seniority: this is effectively a hands-on CTO role with complete technical ownership, 30-day prototype parity, a 90-day launch target, and responsibility for security, GDPR, safeguarding, reliability, and hiring.
strengths: Published agent-first engineering opening with remote work from anywhere
Direct alignment with multi-agent orchestration, reusable skills, context systems, tool integrations, evaluation, and human approval gates
Strong match for APIs, authentication, transactions, concurrency, queues, idempotency, recovery, object storage, payments, and CI/CD
Renderperk proves distributed production ownership across 11 microservices, GPU workloads, queues, storage, payments, observability, and deployment
Times Astro proves production conversational AI, Langfuse tracing, model comparison, evaluation, feedback analysis, and large-scale analytics
Role values shipped evidence over formal credentials
Small team makes proof-first founder outreach valuable
gaps: No prior formal CTO, staff-engineer, or founding-engineer title
Limited evidence of independently owning GDPR, safeguarding, and security for a platform used by minors
TypeScript full-stack development is not Paarth's strongest or preferred ecosystem
No demonstrated experience hiring and leading a production engineering team
Role expects complete technical accountability from day one rather than an internship ramp
unknowns: Salary, equity, vesting, and employment or contracting structure
Whether worldwide remote explicitly supports India
Current funding, runway, revenue, waitlist size, and committed launch customers
Actual codebase maturity, test coverage, architecture, and backlog size
Existing security, GDPR, data-residency, safeguarding, and legal support
Whether the founder would consider an 8-12 week paid trial
Why the job board uses the former Cloud College identifier
evaluation.outreach_angle: Lead with the exact overlap between FrontierU's agent-first model and Paarth's production systems: multi-agent orchestration, bounded task lanes, evaluation and tracing, backend reliability, queues, payments, observability, and incident debugging. Acknowledge the CTO-level scope. Propose a paid, milestone-based trial whose first 30 days audit the codebase and agent workflow, establish quality and security gates, and take one incomplete critical journey to production-like acceptance. Ask about India contracting, compensation, runway, and conversion.
evaluation.proposed_artifact: Prepare a FrontierU first-30-days technical plan: week 1 codebase, security, data-flow, dependency, and agent-workflow audit; week 2 isolated worktrees, bounded agent lanes, acceptance criteria, CI evidence, and approval gates; week 3 complete one critical end-to-end member journey with permissions, persistence, failure handling, and tests; week 4 deploy to production-like staging with traces, evaluations, alerts, rollback, backup-restore evidence, and a measured prototype-parity report.

pipeline.next_action: Write the requested first-30-days plan and agent-driven engineering case study, submit the published application, then send a personalized LinkedIn message to founder Andries Kerpestein proposing a paid milestone-based trial.
pipeline.notes: The listing is titled Founding Engineer but describes a hands-on CTO mandate. Posted July 14, 2026 and still publicly accessible. Do not mark outreach or application as sent until Paarth confirms it.
